title: CapCutデスクトップ版でSeedance2.5を使って映像を制作する
content:
CapCutデスクトップ版でSeedance2.5を使って映像を制作する
少女キャラクターはGPTimage2で生成したAIガールを用意してSeedance2.5の動画に使用する

author.name: ChiakiAkagi 還暦のAIイリュージョニスト

tips:
CapCutデスクトップ版でSeedance2.5を使って映像を制作する

en.content:
Creating a video with Seedance 2.5 in the CapCut desktop version  
For the girl character, prepare an AI girl generated with GPTimage2 and use her in the Seedance 2.5 video

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
This video doesn’t look like AI at all.  
Her voice, facial expressions, and everything about the way she tries to help rescue the kitten swept away by the river feel incredibly real.  
The smile after the rescue is the best part.  
It was made with CapCut’s Seedance 2.5. The girl is an AI girl from GPTimage2.  
#capcutseedance25 #capcutcpp @capcutapp @capcutapp_jp https://t.co/bQ5gLGZ0dE
---
